content:
Rain

It came at last, the longed-for rain,
It washed the dust from roof and lane.
It drummed a rhythm on the zinc,
It made the thirsty gardens drink.
The children danced with joy and glee,
Beneath the mango, fig and tree.
The earth, so dry, so cracked, so worn,
Was washed, and made, and born anew.
